kamloops.title: Woven baskets gifted to Okanagan elder, replacing those lost to wildfire
kamloops.description: A B.C. woman who read an Okanagan Indian Band elder's story of losing treasured items in the Bradley Creek wildfire gifted him four woven baskets, believed to be of Syilx origin, from her home.

kamloops.title: Orange Shirt Society kiosk opens in Kamloops, after years of companies selling unaffiliated merchandise
kamloops.description: After years of unaffiliated companies profiting off of Orange Shirt Day, the founder of the Orange Shirt Society has opened her own kiosk to sell official merchandise bearing the society's legal trademark to the term "Every Child Matters."
